title: front-warehouse
intro:
Sources of the `a_Projects` group, split from diegonmarcos/front-projects (#1072, which itself was split from diegonmarcos.github.io). Paths mirror the original layout (`a_Projects/...` at the repo root). The Pages workflow of diegonmarcos.github.io checks this repo out over its workspace and publishes it.
History stays in diegonmarcos.github.io (snapshot copy). `SPLIT-PATHS.txt` lists the overlaid paths.
